summary: The sealed local evidence supports a completed same-budget, same-protocol negative normal comparison. No prediction-derived GT, self-normalized primary accuracy, phantom metric, changed native stop rule or M0 warm start was found in the inspected active path. Both arms retained E0. Raw rows, dataset payloads, seventeen dependencies and cold normal recovery prevent an unqualified reproduction or effectiveness claim.
auditor: fresh native Codex reviewer; actual model/effort UNATTESTED
audit_scope_definition: Completed normal pair: direct source/data-flow and sealed local evidence review plus deterministic arithmetic; not a new experiment, checkpoint recovery or independent raw-coordinate evaluation.

gt_provenance.details: Reviewed active GT construction is dataset-derived. Prediction coordinates do not manufacture evaluation targets. Dataset payload bytes and exact expression membership remain unverified (L01/L02). Input proposal boxes are separate group-free detections; --butd_gt and --butd_cls are absent. Forward inputs exclude GT box/mask coordinates.

score_normalization.details: Actual last/bbs accuracy counts root targets whose standard box IoU is strictly >0.25 or >0.50, divided by 9508 dataset targets. No model-own max/min/mean score denominator was found on this active path. Semantic softmax/token-map ranking and geometry feature scaling are not accuracy normalization. Diagnostic full256 oracle coverage remains separate.

result_existence.details: All 100 R2 inputs exist and match their exact seals. Both native metric histories, stop records, terminal statuses, intakes, log tails, diagnostics and summary CSV agree on all six epoch rows and actual termination. The current tracker has dated COMPLETE entries. Its earlier Not started entries and the frozen protocol flags are historical. R1 contained a stale tracker alias; R2 corrects only that seal defect. Raw evaluation rows and full logs are unavailable.

dead_code.details: The active trainer calls GroundingEvaluator.evaluate for last_ on each validation batch, synchronizes, reads last/bbs top-1 counts and writes native_metrics. Existing mask/semantic/top-k/bbf diagnostics are not substituted for primary accuracy. The separate detection/AP branch is inactive for the selected ScanRefer path; commented DIoU loss call sites supply no evidence.

scope.details: Both original normal arms completed E0/E1/E2 full9508 logged evaluation with 256 candidates and two full training epochs, seed2027, 9166 loops and 73328 row visits each. Eight epochs was a maximum. Exact raw-row membership, robust effects, other datasets, cold recovery and a successful new contribution are unsupported.

eval_type.details: Primary accuracy is real_gt under the inspected native dataset/evaluator implementation. GT-based repair/break, same-selected-query endpoint and full256 candidate coverage records are diagnostic only; none is a deployable selection score or a replacement for last/bbs. Dataset byte validation remains limited.

blocking_findings_definition: Confirmed integrity violations that invalidate the qualified completed-pair comparison. An empty list does not certify missing evidence, satisfy the user goal, accept a model promotion or approve another launch.

limitation_findings.title: Raw normal evaluation rows are unavailable locally
limitation_findings.details: All six native_rows_epoch000/001/002.jsonl files have recorded hashes and sizes, but no local row payload was available. Diagnostic arithmetic and native counts were cross-checked; individual boxes, IoUs, input fingerprints, unique expression IDs, and cross-arm equality were not independently recomputed. Logged assertions are not an independent raw-row recount.

limitation_findings.title: Dataset payload provenance is source-traced, not payload-rehashed
limitation_findings.details: GT flows from ScanRefer object IDs and original ScanNet object segment points into center_label, size_gts and gt_masks. The actual filtered annotation JSON/TXT, cached train/val_v3scans.pkl, scan point/aggregation payloads and split membership were not supplied for an independent data-byte audit. Exact scene counts and annotation identity were not recounted. The reviewed native protocol is not independently certified as identical to an external official-paper protocol.

limitation_findings.title: Seventeen unique staged dependencies lack matching local bytes
limitation_findings.details: The 240-entry two-arm stage manifest has 206 entries bound to matching local bytes; 34 entries represent 17 unique unavailable dependencies. These include models/encoder_decoder_layers.py, models/modules.py, ScanNet metadata/split files, parser word lists, a figure and the pointnet2 binary. Other local copies of the two Python files had different hashes and were not substituted. Exact expected hashes and remote paths are preserved in SOURCE_HASH_BINDINGS.json. Shared manifests establish historical hash agreement, not current independent inspection of these missing bytes.

limitation_findings.title: No cold recovery or serialized trained optimizer counter audit
limitation_findings.details: Two complete epochs and one optimizer/scheduler step per loop imply 9166 step calls per arm. No normal checkpoint was loaded, and trained optimizer step counters, scheduler recovery, RNG restoration and cold native restart were not verified. M0 exercised two updates and same-process recovery only; it cannot establish normal recovery. Retained E0 archives contain zero optimizer state entries, so they do not prove trained optimizer recovery.

limitation_findings.title: Normal E0 outputs are not bitwise identical in saved diagnostics
limitation_findings.details: Both arms have the same E0 native hits 5677/4920, and supplemental E0 tensor manifests agree across 1295 tensors. However E0 row hashes/sizes differ and raw_below_zero_by_axis is [198202,211220,167258] for final_duplicate versus [198201,211221,167257] for coarse_endpoint. The cause is not established without row data; equal totals and model manifests must not be promoted into identical forward-output evidence.

limitation_findings.title: One seed, one validation dataset, two trained epochs per arm
limitation_findings.details: Seed 2027 is the only paired normal run. The protocol allowed up to eight epochs; both actually stopped at two. This supports a bounded within-protocol comparison, not multi-seed robustness, an eight-epoch completed comparison, test generalization, Nr3D/Sr3D results, or a verified independent third mechanism. M0 and observed normal responsibility records do not demonstrate non-root matched-target coverage, although the source retains generic original targets.

limitation_findings.title: Original remote state and full logs were not revisited
limitation_findings.details: This is a local cached-evidence audit. Both original normal paths, native statuses, exits and captured intake hashes were checked. Only 20000-byte train-log tails are available for each normal arm, not the full original logs. The current remote filesystem, runtime process history and original remote payloads were not independently rehashed.

limitation_findings.title: Archive receipts support content identity with explicit limits
limitation_findings.details: The independently read control/coarse archive receipts and 1295-entry model manifests agree at E0. Both reconstructed local best.pth paths exist at 614926031 bytes. Their checkpoint payloads were not loaded or rehashed by this reviewer. They are content reconstructions, not original ZIP-byte copies. The historical control source C:\Users\gb\.codex\archives\pvg_native_normal_20261010\best.pth is currently absent; the E-drive control reconstruction is currently present and is named as the coarse reconstruction source. This does not establish identical forwards, raw rows, or trained-state cold recovery.

limitation_findings.title: Fresh reviewer route is same-family and actual model is unattested
limitation_findings.details: A fresh native reviewer task was requested with fork_turns=none, model=gpt-6-astra and reasoning_effort=max. The returned task identifier does not attest actual backend model/effort. Both actual fields remain UNATTESTED. The semantic review is same-family/provisional; deterministic file and arithmetic checks have their own recorded outcomes.

claim_acceptance_blocks.detail: Retained 5677/4920 < current 5724/4945; no single complete model meets the user goal.
Best trained coarse is +1/-178 versus retained E0; small paired-control differences do not establish an effective new mechanism.
L01-L05/L07-L09 prevent raw, full-source, cold-recovery or cross-family acceptance claims.

source_and_initialization.matching: Original last Hungarian indices, full original target dictionaries and matched-count normalization; no rematching.
source_and_initialization.coefficient: (10 * native bbox loss + 2 * native GIoU loss) / (num_decoder_layers + 1)
source_and_initialization.fresh_meaning: Fresh normal run and optimizer from shared official/G/A/B pretrained initialization; not random-from-scratch training.

claims.claim: Both matched-endpoint normal arms completed under the shared stop rule and equal actual training budgets.
claims.qualifier: Supported by sealed local native records and source; no cold optimizer-state audit.

claims.claim: Coarse exceeds duplicate-final at shared trained epochs.
claims.qualifier: E1 +27/+7 and E2 +26/+25 hits on this seed and protocol; no multi-seed or cross-arm raw-row proof.

claims.claim: The auxiliary coarse endpoint yields a new stronger retained model or effective third mechanism.
claims.qualifier: Coarse best trained E1 is +1/-178 versus E0; both best overall checkpoints remain E0.

claims.claim: One complete model meets the newer 60.2%/52.0% requirement.
claims.qualifier: Requires 5724/4945 hits; retained 5677/4920 is short 47/25. Metrics from different epochs cannot be combined.

claims.claim: The experiment isolates a sole geometric degradation cause or proves a missing-gradient bug.
claims.qualifier: Endpoint losses affect upstream states and query selection; M0 gradients exist and normal query selections change.

claims.claim: GT is prediction-derived or primary accuracy self-normalized.
claims.qualifier: The inspected active path uses dataset GT and target-count accuracy; this is a bounded source/evidence finding, not a universal fraud guarantee.

claims.claim: All original staged bytes, raw rows, exact E0 outputs and cold normal recovery have been independently verified.
claims.qualifier: L01-L05 and L07-L08 explicitly prevent these claims.

claims.claim: M0 is a full-normal accuracy result audit.
claims.qualifier: M0 is two updates per arm and same-process recovery evidence only; this separate audit covers the completed normal pair.

claims.claim: Robustness, Nr3D/Sr3D generalization or paper-level protocol superiority is established.
claims.qualifier: One ScanRefer validation seed and two trained epochs per arm do not supply those results.

actions: Use this result only with the stated single-seed, two-epoch, sealed-local-evidence qualifiers; retain E0 and do not promote a new mechanism.
Before claiming an independent raw evaluation, supply the six saved row payloads matching recorded hashes and independently recount IoU, IDs, fingerprints and cross-arm E0 differences.
Before claiming complete reproduction, supply byte-matching missing dependencies and source dataset payload/split hashes; do not substitute different local source copies.
Before claiming cold native recovery, supply trained full-checkpoint restoration evidence and optimizer/scheduler/RNG counter checks; M0 and E0 model archives are insufficient.
Keep the historical 5705/4945 protocol target distinguishable from the current 5724/4945 acceptance target in future work.
